description_en: Queries the information of convenience users, such as usernames, email addresses, and remarks
description_zh: 查询便捷账号信息，例如用户名、邮箱地址、备注名称等
kebab_example: aliyun eds-user describe-users --max-results 10 --next-token 'caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a****' --filter 'a*m' --filter-map key=alice --end-user-ids alice --exclude-end-user-ids tony --org-id 'org-4mdgc1cocc59z****' --group-id 'ug-12341234****' --biz-type null --solution-id null --show-extras '{"key":"ResourcesCount: true"}' --filter-with-assigned-resources key=false --is-query-all-sub-orgs true --filter-with-assigned-resource key=example-string --status 0 --exclude-group-id 'ug-12341234****' --business-channel ENTERPRISE --api-version 2021-03-08 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUsers

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page in a paging query.

Valid values: 1 to 500.
Default value: 200
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。  

取值范围：1~500。  
默认值：200
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next query. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call. If a query does not return all results, a non-empty NextToken is returned. You can use the returned NextToken to continue the query
parameters.help_zh:
下一次查询的Token。首次调用接口时无需设置该参数。      
如果一次查询结果并没有完整返回所有的结果，则返回的NextToken不为空。您可以在查询中上传返回的NextToken继续查询
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy search string, which supports matching usernames (EndUserId) and email addresses (Email). This field supports wildcards (*). For example, if you set this field to `a*m`, all results whose username or email address starts with `a` and ends with `m` are returned
parameters.help_zh: 模糊搜索字符串，支持匹配用户名（EndUserId）和邮箱（Email）。该字段支持使用通配符（*），例如将该字段设为`a*m`，则返回用户名或邮箱以`a`开头、以`m`结尾的所有结果
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match condition map for user information, which supports usernames, nicknames, mobile phone numbers, email addresses, remarks, and employee IDs
parameters.help_zh: 用户信息的模糊匹配条件映射，支持用户名、昵称、手机号、邮箱、备注和工号
parameters.name: filter_map

parameters.help_en: The list of usernames (EndUserId) for exact match
parameters.help_zh: 需精确匹配的用户名（EndUserId）列表
parameters.name: end_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of usernames (EndUserId) to be exactly excluded
parameters.help_zh: 需精确排除的用户名（EndUserId）列表
parameters.name: exclude_end_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The organization ID for exact match
parameters.help_zh: 按组织ID精确匹配，查询归属该组织的账号列表
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en: The user group ID for exact match
parameters.help_zh: 按用户组ID精确匹配，查询归属该用户组的账号列表
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_zh: 该参数不对外开放使用

parameters.help_zh: 该参数不对外开放使用
parameters.name: solution_id

parameters.help_en: The extended user information to query
parameters.name: show_extras

parameters.help_en: Filters users based on whether cloud resources are assigned
parameters.help_zh: 根据否分配云资源筛选用户
parameters.name: filter_with_assigned_resources

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to query users in sub-organizations
parameters.help_zh: 是否查询子组织下的用户
parameters.name: is_query_all_sub_orgs

parameters.help_en: Filters users based on the assignment relationships of specified resources. The map key is the resource type
parameters.help_zh: 按指定资源的分配关系筛选用户，映射键为资源类型
parameters.name: filter_with_assigned_resource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user group used to exclude convenience users
parameters.help_zh: 排除属于指定用户组的便捷账号
parameters.name: exclude_group_id

Desktop: cloud computer.
DesktopGroup: shared cloud computer.
CloudDrive: enterprise cloud disk (personal disk for users).
APP: cloud application

支持的云资源类型：

APP：云应用

AssignedResourceCount.description_en: The number of allocated cloud resources

ResourcePolicyList.description_en: The list of resource policies associated with the user
ResourcePolicyList.description_zh: 用户关联的资源策略列表

Groups.description_en: The collection of user groups to which the convenience user belongs
Groups.description_zh: 便捷账号归属的用户组集合

items.description_zh: 便捷账号归属的用户组属性

IsTenantManager.description_en: Indicates whether the user is a tenant administrator. If the convenience user is activated by an administrator, you must specify a tenant administrator. Notifications, such as password reset requests from end users through the client, are sent to the email address or mobile phone number of the tenant administrator. For more information, see [Create a convenience user]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/214472.html）
IsTenantManager.description_zh: 是否为用户管理员。如果创建的便捷账号是管理员激活类型，则必须指定一位用户管理员，终端用户通过客户端重置密码等通知将发送到该用户管理员的邮箱或手机，详情参见[创建便捷账号]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/214472.html）

JobNumber.description_en: The employee ID of the user

The nickname of the user. The value is obtained in the following order:
RealNickName
Remark
EndUserId
NickName.description_zh:
用户昵称。  
按以下顺序取值：
RealNickName
Remark
EndUserId

便捷账号归属的部门ID。
该参数即将废弃

Orgs.description_zh: 便捷账号归属的部门集合

items.description_zh: 便捷账号归属的部门属性

OrgNamePath.description_en: The name path from the root organization to the current organization
OrgNamePath.description_zh: 从根组织到当前组织的名称路径

OwnerType.description_en:
The convenience user type. Valid values:
Administrator-activated: The administrator sets the username and password. User notifications such as password reset notifications are sent to the email address or mobile phone number of the administrator.
User-activated: The administrator sets the username and the email address or mobile phone number for receiving notifications. User notifications such as the cloud computer activation notification that contains the initial password are sent to the email address or mobile phone number of the user
OwnerType.description_zh:
便捷账号类型，包括：

管理员激活类型，管理员设置用户名及用户密码，重置密码等用户通知将发送到管理员的邮箱或手机。
用户激活类型，管理员设置用户名及用户接收通知的邮件或手机，云电脑开通通知（含初始密码）等用户通知将发送到用户的邮件或手机

PasswordExpireDays.description_en: The password validity period, in days. Valid values: 30 to 365. By default, the password is permanently valid
PasswordExpireDays.description_zh: 密码有效期，单位为天。取值范围为 30～365；默认情况下密码永久有效

PasswordExpireRestDays.description_en: The remaining days of the password validity period
PasswordExpireRestDays.description_zh: 密码有效期的剩余天数

Phone.description_en: The mobile phone number. This parameter is not returned if it is not configured
Phone.description_zh: 手机号，如未设置该参数则不返回该参数

RealNickName.description_en: The display name of the user

Remark.description_en: The remark of the convenience user

UserSource.description_en: The enterprise identity source type of the user source. The backend determines whether to query this field based on the display and hide configurations of the custom columns for the enterprise identity source. Valid values: DINGDING (DingTalk), FEISHU (Lark), WECHAT (WeCom), and ENTRA_ID (Microsoft Entra ID). This field is empty if the column is hidden, not configured, or not associated with an enterprise identity source
UserSource.description_zh: 用户来源的企业身份源类型，由后端根据企业身份源自定义列的显隐配置决定是否查询。取值：DINGDING（钉钉）、FEISHU（飞书）、WECHAT（企业微信）、ENTRA_ID（Microsoft Entra ID）。列隐藏、未配置或无企业身份源关联时为空
UserSource.title_en: 用户来源的企业身份源类型
UserSource.title_zh: 用户来源的企业身份源类型

WyId.description_en: The globally unique ID of the convenience user
